wave c2 (K20, LB-F338, LB-F339, LB-F340, 2026-10-09): re-measured after the doc-engine value predicates. A remote action's pin is the dialect's own entity (an anchored value predicate over uses:, once per file) and the oracle names it (pin: and the uses value, at its first step, GitHub's {owner}/{repo}[/{path}]@{ref} form), so the pins are measured; a run step with an id is the step its id names alone (the key-absent selector, O631) and the oracle writes a positional step only for a run step without one. Definitions 1,516 to 1,754: starter-workflows +13 (13 pins), cli/cli +29 (30 pins, 1 id'd run step), opentelemetry-demo +36 (39 pins, 3 id'd run steps), pytorch +160; every one matched. The pin nodes are byte-identical to the retired wrapper's on all four subjects (357 over every owned file). lang-parity against ghaextract.go still reads MERGE (parity/github-actions.json, GHAPinRef and GHAPinSHA gained)
